system.description:
Additionally at 2nd level, when you deal damage with a Genjutsu you cast or are concentrating on you can select one of the Jutsu’s damage die rolls and treat it as its highest value.

Alternatively, when an affected creature fails a saving throw as a result of a Genjutsu you cast, they become Mentally Compromised on a failed save for the next minute.

activities.label: Mentally Compromised (1 minute)
activities.text: A creature that failed a save against your Genjutsu.

rules.text: Damage from a Genjutsu you cast or concentrate on: treat one of its damage dice as its highest value (set it on the damage card). Or, when a creature fails a save against your Genjutsu, it becomes Mentally Compromised for 1 minute (the button).
